title: Northgate Tire Center Warranty Pricing Bulletin — Price per Tire for a Treadwear Credit by Claim Age
content:
# Price per tire for a treadwear credit, by claim age

**Schedule.** A Northgate Tire Center treadwear credit is prorated on a price per tire — the price that is multiplied by the treadwear remaining mileage share — chosen by the whole calendar months from the package's installation date to the service date of the claim entry (the most recent treadwear claim entry recorded on the package). A month counts once its day of the month is reached.

| Whole months from installation to the claim entry | Price per tire on which the credit is prorated |
|---|---|
| fewer than 36 | the higher of the price paid per tire and the replacement tire charge booked against the claim entry |
| at least 36 and fewer than 60 | the replacement tire charge booked against the claim entry |
| 60 or more | the price paid per tire |

## Definitions used in the schedule

- **Price paid per tire.** The tire unit price on the package less every per-unit price adjustment and every per-unit mail-in rebate credited on the tires' purchase line for the tire item number; the unit price itself where none was credited.
- **Replacement tire charge booked against the claim entry.** The charge for the replacement tire that the package shows linked to that treadwear claim entry.

## Boundary dates (hypothetical, installation on 2022-04-20)

| Claim entry dated | Whole months | Price taken |
|---|---|---|
| 2025-04-19 | 35 | the higher of the two |
| 2025-04-20 | 36 | the replacement tire charge |
| 2027-04-19 | 59 | the replacement tire charge |
| 2027-04-20 | 60 | the price paid per tire |

## Worked figure (hypothetical)

Price paid per tire $140.00, replacement tire charge booked against the claim entry $152.00, remaining mileage share 0.2:

- claim at 30 months: the higher price, $152.00, is prorated: $30.40;
- claim at 40 months: the replacement tire charge, $152.00, is prorated: $30.40;
- claim at 62 months: the price paid, $140.00, is prorated: $28.00.

With a replacement tire charge of $130.00 instead, the 30-month claim takes the higher price, $140.00, giving $28.00.
